display_name: LoRa W24 两方向精确分带混合诊断（Full）
description: Use exact noiseless Full source waveform to project locally or globally onto the convex mixture space of frozen DURA and ordinary long U-Net edits.
authorization: Active LoRa goal explicitly allows isolated source IQ and exact simulator component diagnostics, no target path, Full only.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Exact immutable 300 V source physical IDs and seven Full views; all six frozen W24 controls checked by prediction parity.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only noiseless receive component used only in diagnostic choice among frozen candidate IQ edits. Independent source truth-last. No training or deployment.

checkpoint.initialization: No parameter updates. Frozen source outer DURA and two exact U-Net models plus immutable E104 readout.

sources.role: Frozen source predictions used as a matched comparison after both scratch candidates freeze
Pinned analytic aperture, tracking and generic waveform generator code only, no learned checkpoint
Source-frozen standard and complex U-Net checkpoints with archived same-packet decisions

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No historical restoration weight used in fit, freeze or candidate predictions. Historical outer predictions appended by unchanged physical order for post-freeze paired scoring only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Diagnostic only. Compare exact packet-band constrained mix, chirp-band constrained mix, and chirp-band five fixed endpoints. Source no-noise component read only here.

execution.gpu_policy: One N607 card ordered 3,6,0, >=12 GiB available and existing process cap. Serial CPU waveform generation in initialized worker.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on invalid source lineage or real smoke, incomplete/failing same-packet source parity, missing views or independent score failure.

metric_names: paired six-view and low urban counts

rows.method: Two observed parent directions (DURA and original-loss 24k U-Net). Each of four bands allows real nonnegative weights summing to at most one. Shared packet versus 8 independent chirp weights, and discrete zero/half/full endpoints.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: No training. Same source U_s real smoke and 300 physical V packets × seven Full views, six archived controls and three new exact waveform diagnostics.

notes: Convex space is exactly the hull of zero and the two frozen full edits in each band. Preserve DC and native edges. No F or TX output guides choice.
Exact centers use true signal component in the same source observed coordinate scale. Read W24 only for finished output. Source labels only after all predictions freeze.
Packet-band and chirp-band are isolation ablations of spatial granularity, same directions. All six fixed reference classifications checked by immutable parity.
CPU grid and tiny-scale tests, one scoped P0/P1 review, targeted scale regression resolved. Zero target and no new Residual.
